question:
Five friends named Kishore, Jayan, Lahari, Manyaki and Nalini live on five different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor which is numbered 5. Kishore lives on odd numbered floor but not on third floor and Nalini lives on the bottommost floor. Manyaki and Jayan lives on even numbered floors but Manyaki doesn't lives above Jayan. Lahari lives on the floor immediately above Manyaki.

Who lives on the third floor?
